page: Amazon Web Services x2iedn.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz, with 32 physical cores and hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 2048 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 32 GB of RAM per physical core. Local storage is provided via a 1900 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance supports a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and database performance. The instance achieved a multi-core stress-ng CPU score of 61,947.26 and a Passmark CPU score of 56,826.42, both placing in the top 25% of tested hardware. Database operations on Passmark also scored in the strong tier at 26,144.88. Single-core performance is average, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1,688.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1,893.9. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance, with read-only small block cached bandwidth at 3,352.15 GB/sec and uncached large block write bandwidth at 61.06 GB/sec.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated hardware allocation, this instance offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads, representing a specialized hardware class. The inclusion of local NVMe SSD storage and high network bandwidth reduces the need for external storage provisioning for high-throughput tasks. However, the trade-off lies in its average single-core performance relative to its massive memory capacity. This instance is highly suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale enterprise applications, software compilation, and multi-threaded data processing tasks.
